segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: Okay, let's start. This is the launch planning sync for the Falcon dashboard.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: Priya, can you give us the status on the export feature?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Sure. CSV export is done. PDF export is about seventy percent there, I'll have it finished by next Friday.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: We still haven't decided whether PDF export ships in version one or waits for version two.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: Let's decide now. PDF export ships in version one, since two customers asked for it.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Fine with me. Someone needs to update the pricing page before launch though.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: The other risk is the reporting API rate limit. If we hit it during the demo, charts won't load.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: Marco, can you add caching for the reporting API? Done means charts load under two seconds.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Yes, I'll take the caching work.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: Do we know the launch date yet? Marketing hasn't confirmed.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: No, that's still open. Let's revisit next week.
